systemic_concerns: No hallucinated flaws found in this batch - every watermark, blur, halftone, and hand-anomaly claim spot-checked true, and no obvious flaw was omitted. The weakest field across notes is champion ID: 3 of 7 are hedged guesses (152 Riven-adjacent despite blue hair, 58 Crystal Rose Caitlyn, 199 Coven-style Caitlyn) - acceptable because hedged, but downstream consumers should treat champion fields as low-confidence metadata, not ground truth. Scoring bands are internally consistent: watermarked pieces cap around 3-4, pro splashes get 4-5; the premise that centered watermarks and mushy hands are TOLERATED is correctly encoded rather than airbrushed away.
